name: closing-call-to-action-agents
purpose: The close for a reader who may be a person or an agent: one centred ask in the loud `primary` register of the call to action, under a pixelated, waving texture, with a small segmented switch under the title that picks the way in. Each audience carries an optional copyable line and its actions; under them, a line types its words one after another behind a blinking cursor, then a closing sentence, both the same for every audience so the band keeps its height when the switch changes. The hatched closing frame follows. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'closing-call-to-action-agents', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `call-to-action`, `toggle-group`, `input-group`, `copy-button`, `button`, `frame-box` and `texture-material`. The switch and the typed word are local state.
useWhen: To close a developer page whose reader may be a person or the person's agent.
avoidWhen: For a close on one or two link actions → use `closing-call-to-action` (`primary` for the same loud register without the switch).
related: closing-call-to-action` — the same close without the audience switch.
bestPractices: Keep two audiences; the first one opens.
Keep each copyable line short enough to fit the field; the copy button copies exactly what it shows.
Keep `typedWords` to a few short words; screen readers and reduced motion get the whole list at once.

Place it last on the page, right above `site-footer`, after a hatched `section-gap`. It draws the hatched closing frame itself, so nothing follows it inside the page column: no trailing `SectionGap` and no closing `FrameBox` + `TextureMaterial` (the `shells/website` close is for a page that ends on any other band). `webkit/no-gap-after-closing-section` flags the doubled close.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the call to action as its `h2`; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: typedLead
props.doc: Fixed opening of the typed line, before the typed word.

props.name: typedWords
props.doc: Words typed, held, erased and typed again in order after `typedLead`; the typed line renders only when there are words.

props.name: description
props.doc: Closing sentence under the typed line, the same for every audience.

props.name: audiences
props.doc: The ways in, in switch order; each is `{ value, label, copy?, actions? }` and the first one opens. The switch renders only with two or more.

props.name: audiencesAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the audience switch.

props.name: lineAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the read-only field that shows an audience's copyable line.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ClosingCallToActionAgents from '@aziontech/webkit/closing-call-to-action-agents'

  const typedWords = ['Console', 'CLI', 'MCP server']

  const audiences = [
    {
      value: 'humans',
      label: 'For humans',
      actions: [
        {
          label: 'Start for free',
          href: '/signup',
          kind: 'secondary',
          trailing: true
        },
        {
          label: 'Talk to a specialist',
          href: '/site/contact',
          kind: 'outlined',
          trailing: true
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      value: 'agents',
      label: 'For agents',
      copy: {
        label: 'Copy prompt',
        text: 'Connect Azion MCP: https://mcp.azion.com'
      },
      actions: [
        {
          label: 'Read the agent docs',
          href: '/site/docs/agent-setup',
          kind: 'outlined',
          trailing: true
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <ClosingCallToActionAgents
    anchor="contact"
    title="Built by you, or your agents."
    typed-lead="Drive one platform from the"
    :typed-words="typedWords"
    description="A person and an agent ship the same way."
    audiences-aria-label="Audience"
    line-aria-label="Prompt"
    :audiences="audiences"
  />
</template>
